svg.title: Repository structure of camunda-7-to-8-migration-tooling, drawn as a castle
svg.desc: A cartoon castle. The data-migrator keep stands in the middle, flanked by the diagram-converter, code-conversion and agentic-migration-skills towers. The castle wall holds docs, .github, license, AGENTS.md, pom.xml and .mvn. A drawbridge leads from Camunda 7 into the castle.
